updates.content:
Title: Users may see delays populating data in the threat and vulnerability management tab in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

User impact: Users may see delays populating data in the threat and vulnerability management tab in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users may see delays populating data in the threat and vulnerability management tab in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

User impact: Users may see delays populating data in the threat and vulnerability management tab in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

Current status: We’ve determined that an unexpected increase in data volume is producing latency and resulting in impact. We’ve applied optimizations to increase throughput and process the backlogged data. We expect the backlogged data to be fully processed, remediating impact, by our next scheduled communication update.

Scope of impact: All users in the Central United States are impacted. 

Start time: Monday, October 19, 2026, at 7:00 AM UTC

Root cause: An unexpected increase in data volume is producing latency as it's taking longer than expected to complete these requests.

Next update by: Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC

Title: Users may see delays populating data in the threat and vulnerability management tab in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

User impact: Users may have seen data updates in the threat and vulnerability management tab in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

Final status: We've completed processing of the backlogged data and users are now seeing up to date data population in the threat and vulnerability management tab.

Scope of impact: All users in the Central United States may have seen delays in data population for the threat and vulnerability management tab in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

Start time: Monday, October 19, 2026, at 7:00 AM UTC

End time: Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 5:30 PM UTC

Root cause: An unexpected increase in data volume was producing latency and causing data population requests to take longer than expected to be processed.

Next steps: We're analyzing the unexpected increase in data volume to isolate what changes we can implement to further improve the resiliency and performance of our service infrastructure to ensure similar impact scenarios don't occur in the future.

This is the final update for the event.
